# EasyEDA's ODB++, step 0b, 2026-11-01 (EasyEDA Pro 3.2.206, easyeda-mcp-pro 1.4.0)

- the bridge extension built by `bridge-extension-patch.sh` ("MCP Pro Bridge (depth 12, schematic PDF, ODB++)"), the
  old one uninstalled, the new one imported, EasyEDA restarted (the owner); the capabilities stay the same – the
  handler answers `board.exportGerbers` with format "odb"
- probe board `edakit-probe-odb`: a copy of `examples/coin-cell-led` with D1 turned by 90° (top), R1 on the bottom
  turned by 90°, BT1 `bom: false` as in the example, `[cart] maker = "aisler"`; built with `schematic create`,
  `schematic layout`, `pcb parts --write`, `pcb dump`, `pcb apply`, `route all`; exported with `edakit fab --out`
  (the patched `easyeda_export_odb`, `unit = "mm"`) and by hand (File > Export > ODB++, dialog: File Name, Option
  "One Key Export" | "Custom Config"; then "Do you want to check the DRC first?" – "No, Continue Exporting")
- component layers: `comp_+_top` (BT1, D1, SW1) and `comp_+_bot` (R1), each `CMP` with package, place, rotation,
  mirror, designator and the device name (`NCD0805R1_C84256`, `0805W8F1500T5E`, `TS-1187A-B-A-B` – the MPN of an LCSC
  part, sometimes with the LCSC number appended), `PRP` Footprint, Designator, Device, Comment, Value (`150_u03a9` for
  150 Ω); no LCSC property – F-7 matches the BOM by MPN
- rotation: D1 90° in EasyEDA and the CPL is `270.0 N` in the ODB++, R1 on the bottom 90° is `270.0 N` too – clockwise,
  as F-7 assumes; EasyEDA writes mirror N also on `comp_+_bot` (the ODB++ test data writes M there); F-7 reads the side
  from the layer
- parts kept out of EasyEDA's BOM: BT1 (Add into BOM off) is in `comp_+_top` like any other part, no attribute marks
  it – way b of ordering.md: the job lists it not to place, the skill marks it on AISLER's page
- the export through the tool is in inch although `unit = "mm"` is passed, the one by hand in mm; the tool's archive
  has 30 empty `custom_layer<n>` folders and no `drill_drawing_layer`, the one by hand the other way round; the rest
  is the same board – both pass SYNC.odb against the run's Gerber, drill, BOM and CPL files
- the bridge's call names no file: EasyEDA's tgz arrives as `undefined` in the run folder (`ARTIFACT_DIR`) –
  `export_odb` removes it after packing `odb_main.zip`
- SYNC.odb at first: top mask 31 spots (1.714 mm² at BT1.1), bottom mask 8 (R1's pads), copper and paste one raster
  column at SW1, silkscreen slivers along BT1's arcs. The masks: `Raster.render` drew EasyEDA's RoundRect (corners
  0.1016 mm) as an obround, the ODB++ has `rect…xr2.0`; drawn as its rectangle (`rr_box`, SYNC.odb only – the fab
  hash keeps raster v1) and with the edge tolerance of 5.10 every layer is equal
- `probe_2026-11-01/`: `overlay/` (edakit.toml, the board file and its geometry over a copy of coin-cell-led) and
  `run/main/` (the run's files SYNC.odb reads; the drawing layers left out) – tests/test_odb.py,
  test_f7_on_easyeda_s_own_export
- on the way: `easyeda_pcb_components` listed D1 and R1 at rotation 0 on layer 1 right after `pcb apply`, while
  `PCB_PrimitiveComponent.get` read 90° and layer 2 (bottom); `DMT_Project` offers `createProject` and
  `deleteProject` (the latter refuses the open project)
